maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from gaming content, Virtual Sports, interactive games and gaming machines/hardware for operators, not mainly repairs or replacement.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are licensed gaming, betting and lottery operators; players' wagers fund revenue, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from its own games, Virtual Sports and technology; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Server-based gaming systems, hardware and Virtual Sports are embedded in operators' retail and online channels; switching means certification and downtime.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; content can be swapped, but embedded systems and hardware raise switching costs.
